newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Duma imposes tax on T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Russian Duma imposes tax on T-bills.

text.p: Russia's State Duma, lower house of parliament, extended on Wednesday a 15-percent income tax to earnings from operations with government securities.
Treasury bills and government bonds had previously been exempt from the 15-percent tax on profits from operations with securities.
But the Duma passed the tax law amendment removing the exemption for government securities in a first reading.
The amendment must pass three readings in all.
The amendment is part of a package of tax laws which need to be handled before Friday's debate on the 1997 budget.
Last month the Duma rejected the government securities amendment when the package of amendments was initially debated.
The Duma on Wednesday also voted to impose a tax on cash purchases of hard currency, but decided to leave a discussion of the tax rate on these transactions until the second reading.
Previously the government had suggested a 1.5 percent tax on currency purchases.
